release_numbers: Assigned from actual release scope; sprint IDs remain stable.
ownership_rule: Each current requirement has exactly one delivery owner; P01 inventories and P09 accepts every mandatory requirement.
prerequisites_rule: Module evidence and contracts must be ready before dependent implementation. P01 may finish preparation with blockers, but final parity cannot pass with unresolved mandatory requirements.
completion_rule: Direct reference evidence, independent validation, predefined tolerances and a complete user scenario are required; implementation presence alone does not establish parity.
planning_estimates: Calendar and effort follow P01; P03/P04 may split into child sprints while parents remain open.
